Description: Response time increased from 300 ms to 4.8 seconds. CPU utilization is normal, but database query latency has increased substantially.
Order lookups became slow after a release. Query traces show a sequential scan over the order table, while application CPU remains near its usual level.
Error: Order lookup query exceeded the 4000 ms slow-query threshold.

Description: Creating orders is slow, but reading existing orders remains fast. Database sessions show writes waiting behind a long-running transaction.
Error: Lock wait timeout exceeded while inserting an order.

Description: Order-history pages became slow immediately after a cache restart. Cache hit rate dropped sharply and database read traffic increased.
Error: Cache lookup missed; fallback database query exceeded its latency threshold.

Description: Order requests are timing out across all instances. CPU utilization is above 95%, while database query latency is close to its normal level.
Error: Request timed out waiting for an available application worker.

Description: The service becomes progressively slower during the day and several instances restart. Memory consumption rises until the container limit is reached.
Error: Container terminated after exceeding its memory limit.

Description: Orders are accepted promptly but confirmations arrive more than twenty minutes later. The background processing queue has a growing backlog.
Error: Order confirmation job exceeded its queue-age threshold.

Description: Checkout is slow only when an order requires a stock check. Database access is normal, but inventory-service responses often take several seconds.
Error: Inventory availability request timed out after 5000 ms.

Description: Only order-history requests covering more than a year are slow. Requests for the last month return within the normal response time.
Error: Historical order query exceeded its execution time limit.

Description: Order requests intermittently fail following a database restart. Some application connections recover while others continue to fail.
Error: Database connection closed unexpectedly during query execution.

Description: Response times rise while the scheduled reporting job runs. Database storage latency is elevated, but application CPU utilization remains normal.
Error: Database read operation exceeded the storage latency threshold.

Description: Order placement fails only from one region. Affected instances cannot resolve the internal database hostname, while the other region is healthy.
Error: Temporary failure in name resolution for the order database.

Description: One customer reports a slow order page on a mobile connection. Server-side request latency remains normal and the issue has not been reproduced.
Support reports that the order dashboard feels slower than usual. No timestamps, affected operations, or measurements have been provided yet.
Order updates return errors after a schema deployment. Read-only requests still work, and the new application instances expect a database column that is absent.
Error: Database query failed: requested order column does not exist.
